title: The walkthrough doctor steps depend on the host Product entry being fresh
body:
Why: the first-day walkthrough runs krn doctor, which exits 78 whenever the host Product entry lags origin/main (init and clone doctor steps failed for that reason alone on 2026-11-15).
Outcome: the walkthrough judges those doctor steps independent of host entry freshness, or runs doctor against a hermetic entry.
Files: scripts/first-day-walkthrough.ts and its test.
Proof: the walkthrough passes with a stale host entry.
